summary: Iter 244 - All features tested successfully. Backend: 12/15 pytest tests passed (3 skipped due to no catering requests created). Manual verification confirmed Catering-Cancel, Slack-Webhook privacy, and Skip-Note features work correctly. Frontend: All UI components verified including Slack-Webhook block, Skip-Note input, and reason picker.
seed_data_creation: Used existing demo desks and rooms with catering enabled for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 244 fully tested. Features verified: (1) Catering-Cancel: POST /api/catering-requests/{id}/transition with status='cancelled' works - owner can cancel own CR, cancellation_reason saved, double-cancel returns 409. (2) Slack-Webhook: PUT /api/users/me/office-days with slack_webhook_url saves it, GET returns slack_webhook_configured=true (NOT the URL for privacy), PUT with empty string clears it. (3) Slack Generate: POST /api/users/me/office-days/generate returns slack_notified field (true/false), invalid URLs return false without 500. (4) Skip-Note: POST /api/users/me/office-days/skip with reason + note saves skip_note, office-week shows note in absent entry. (5) Regression: All Iter 243 skip-reasons features still work. Frontend: Profile page has Slack-Webhook block (data-testid='office-day-slack-block') with input when not configured, status + clear button when configured. Skip-Note input (data-testid='skip-note-{booking_id}') appears before reason buttons in the skip picker.
